minimum_acceptance_checks_before_any_fac: Use original SEC disclosed security names, share classes, CUSIP/ISIN and legal-entity lineage to assign permanent security identities; explicitly distinguish original SNDK, ALTR and BRCM from later reused or successor tickers and old Broadcom from Avago/AVGO.

Show dated raw daily opens/closes/volume and exchange/currency for every original held security over each decision-relevant period; include delisting/acquisition terminal treatment and flag missing dates. Do not silently remove missing names or renormalize reported weights.

Provide unadjusted prices plus splits, cash dividends and other distributions with ex-dates and, when a decision feature uses them, first-public timing. Current hindsight-adjusted closes alone are not point-in-time proof.
Check 2010-10-31 and 2017-03-31 basket positive controls against original reported share counts and fair values, then audit all quarterly baskets and price coverage before fitting.
Preserve received provider bytes, schema/license identity, snapshot version, SHA-256, Yanxuan NAS receipt and scoped restore; map accepted series through native Qlib D/DatasetH/Recorder.

Only after source qualification freeze one feature formula, original Stage1 receiver/control, cost and information gates. Any accepted feature first runs its own full funded 0bp Stage1-derived Tiered account versus SOXX.
